trends.name: Global Rate Uncertainty & Debt Stress
trends.summary: Concerns are mounting across government bond markets regarding high global rates and widening sovereign debt (US midterms, Europe, Australia). Rating agencies are advising extreme caution, signaling that bond market appetite is highly volatile. Investors must factor in persistent macro rate sensitivity.

trends.name: AI Market Valuation Correction
trends.summary: The market is showing signs of cooling from the 'AI hype' peak, leading to visible stock index weakness and profit-taking. Experts are debating whether the recent dips represent a major correction or a 'golden buying opportunity,' suggesting sector rotation may be imminent.

trends.name: Escalating Geopolitical & Policy Risks
trends.summary: Increased geopolitical friction, including reported military strikes (Iran) and legal battles (Supreme Court), are creating significant policy uncertainty. Midterm election outcomes and international law changes are adding layers to investment risk assessment.

trends.name: Commercial AI Revenue Diversification
trends.summary: Large tech players are shifting the focus from pure hype to quantifiable, commercial use cases. Companies are proving that their AI capabilities translate into robust, high-growth revenue outside of government contracts, offering a more stable investment thesis.

trends.name: High-Yield Credit Stress & Ratings
trends.summary: Credit market stress is reaching historical levels, particularly concerning CCC-rated debt. While headlines appear upbeat, specialized debt markets signal deep caution, warning that the risk of downgrades and default in lower credit quality segments is heightened.

trends.name: Global Supply Chain Dependencies (China)
trends.summary: The reliance of advanced US tech sectors, such as humanoid AI and advanced semiconductors, on specialized Chinese components is emerging as a critical geoeconomic risk. Supply chain resilience is becoming a key investor metric.

trends.name: Semiconductor & Foundary Bottlenecks
trends.summary: The fundamental infrastructure needed for the tech boom (e.g., Intel's foundry push, specialized equipment) faces critical testing due to massive demand and prior investment drops. Manufacturing capacity remains a choke point.

trends.name: Market Momentum Loss & Contrarian Signals
trends.summary: Negative sentiment dominates, with indexes losing momentum and leveraged bets failing. This environment highlights value investors repositioning away from perceived bubble stocks and searching for bargains.
